name: Common Room
desc1: The inn's common room is smaller than some, but is still quite cozy
desc2: and welcoming. There is a single low, round table in the centre of the
desc3: room, but there are no chairs-- plush cushions on the floor are
desc4: provided for sitting upon. Ornate brass lamps affixed to the walls
desc5: provide a smoky light, and incense burners create an ethereal blue
